description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to safe prime generation, modular arithmetic, and primality testing, specifically for the SRP (Secure Remote Password) authentication system. It includes functions for generating safe primes, modular exponentiation, and primality checks using the OpenSSL BN (Big Number) library.

methods.name: trialdiv
methods.description: Performs trial division to check if a BigInteger is divisible by small primes less than 256.

methods.name: sophie_germain
methods.description: Generates a Sophie-Germain prime within a specified range.

methods.name: t_makeconfent
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with a safe prime and generator for cryptographic use.

methods.name: t_makeconfent_c
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with a composite safe prime and generator.

methods.name: t_putconfent
methods.description: Outputs a configuration entry to a file.

methods.name: BigIntegerBitLen
methods.description: Returns the bit length of a BigInteger.

methods.name: BigIntegerCheckPrime
methods.description: Checks if a BigInteger is prime using OpenSSL BN library.

methods.name: BigIntegerModInt
methods.description: Computes the modulus of a BigInteger with an unsigned int.

methods.name: BigIntegerMod
methods.description: Computes the modulus of a BigInteger with another BigInteger.

methods.name: BigIntegerLShift
methods.description: Left shifts a BigInteger by a specified number of bits.
